selection_rule: After C1T source recovery and exact wall analysis, choose exactly one applicable transformation id and one finite parameter grid before any discovery arm starts. If no entry is applicable, stop PRESEARCH_STOP. No backup transformation is allowed.

entries.operation: uniform or explicitly bounded nonuniform vertex blow-up by cliques or independent sets
entries.required_effect_forecast: signed change for every controlling graph invariant and every theorem baseline
exact translation of hypotheses and controlling invariants under complementation

entries.operation: line graph, bounded edge subdivision, or their fixed one-step composition
entries.required_effect_forecast: signed objective effect plus applicability and shortcut-risk audit

entries.operation: one fixed block sum, voltage lift, or cover construction
entries.required_effect_forecast: separator/fiber effects and exact hypothesis preservation

entries.operation: one frozen orbit of at most two edge additions, deletions, switches, or contractions
entries.required_effect_forecast: controlling-term signs, label transport, and isomorph rejection rule

entries.operation: one bounded quotient or subalgebra construction
entries.required_effect_forecast: premise preservation and a literal failing conclusion certificate

entries.operation: row permutation reduction or bounded multiplication-table cell surgery
entries.required_effect_forecast: constraint preservation, symmetry quotient, and certificate replay

entries.operation: one bounded transition/letter modification preserving a preregistered defect
entries.required_effect_forecast: defect sign and explicit shortcut-risk bound

entries.operation: one semantics-preserving normalized state representation followed by a bounded local move
entries.required_effect_forecast: bijection or bisimulation proof and signed objective effect

entries.operation: one corner/profile transfer or closed two-color exchange family
entries.required_effect_forecast: exact profile delta, feasibility, and closure conditions

entries.operation: one bounded add/delete/swap operation on a finite object encoding
entries.required_effect_forecast: constraint preservation, canonicalization, and signed statistic effect

forbidden_adaptation: activating a second transformation after any arm outcome is visible
expanding the parameter grid after a near miss
using a selected target to add a new library entry during Method v1.2
